text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... That was a completely different
way of running compared to Espo...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Where did it come from...?
This hidden power of Julio's...
Transcend, who was running alongside her, could feel it firsthand, but couldn't analyze it. However...
(Beep!)

The Cinemagun captured it without fail.
One of the reasons behind that strength.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chan, Trainer-chan, did you find anything out?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Wait, white sand...?! 
You mean the Funabashi one we talked about before the race...?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it was stuck to your leg...
Yeah, it was on your leg...

text_block_list.text: It points to only one thing.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Furio.
Even now... you still visit your hometown in Funabashi, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Are you still training with your friends back home even now?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. I went out to Funabashi this morning too,
went for a light run... and centered myself.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Funabashi, the place that raised me.
I want to bring that strength to the JRA and prove our might."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"That is my reason for trying so hard.
The reason I can hang in there and endure."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Yes, in other words...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Love for one's hometown," huh. To think an Umamusume
could become this strong for a reason like that...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Furio, I might not fully understand
how you feel. But...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I think I understand, just a little.
The desire to do your best for a place you hold dear."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...?
Could it be that you are as well?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I started running purely out
of curiosity, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, it's not entirely just for myself.
There are people I want to entertain, after all."

text_block_list.name: Elderly Parishioner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tran-chan. You're running in another race, huh?
My wife and I will be watching.

text_block_list.name: Lady with Belly Piercing
text_block_list.text:
Things have been kinda dreary lately.
Cheer me up, will ya?

text_block_list.name: Northern Child
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, mister.
When is Tora-chan coming to visit again?

text_block_list.name: Northern Man
text_block_list.text:
She'll be back soon enough.
Along with fun stories to tell from the race.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I was just thinking how nice it would be to make their everyday lives a little more exciting and heart-pounding.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... In the sense of repaying a debt...
they are a bit similar, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Um, in that case, we...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—No, it's nothing.
Well, see you later.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

Furioso's expression, which had been stiff all this time,
seemed to soften just a little as she walked away.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Man, there really are all kinds of Umamusume out there,
huh, Trainy?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Defiance, hometown pride... Their reasons for running are all so different. Truly a colorful variety."
choice_data_list: Yeah. And all of it was valuable information.
Right. And all of it was valuable information.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
And that leaves—just one more.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Once I have Smart Falcon's information,
all the necessary data will be fully complete.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
If we analyze, aggregate, and incorporate all of that, what will happen...?
It's thrilling, isn't it!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I wonder what we'll be able to see.
Yeah, I wonder what you can see.

text_block_list.text:
Beyond that lies an unknown discovery.
Something that will bring about
an evolution to Transcend's running.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So, Trai-chan, got any leads on Smart Falcon?
Like what race she's likely to enter next.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
That falcon's pretty quick on its feet, but
we've gotta catch it before summer comes.

I had been keeping a close eye on Smart Falcon's moves in my own way.
And the race she's likely to enter is...
choice_data_list: The Teio Sho at Oi in June looks like our best bet.
The Teio Sho at Oi in June seems like the best bet, right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm.
That seems like the most likely possibility.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: S-So, how is it? Do you think you'll be ready in time to run with Falco-chan by June?
Smart Falcon boasts a terrifying ability to break away; she won't be caught so easily.

However, there are still four months until the Teio Sho.
There's a mountain of things we can do between now and then.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Alright, then the Teio Sho it is.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"One more step. Just one more step.
Gather all the information, and—"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Let's find our thrills!
Our absolute greatest happiness!
choice_data_list: Yeah, leave the training menu to me!
Yeah, leave the training menu to me!

text_block_list.text:
Transcend's motivation is at an all-time high.
Her spirits soar toward the coming summer.

Morale was high heading into her next race, the Teio Sho...
and yet...
